messages:
sara_support: Received an urgent escalation from ACME (tenant: acme-prod). They can't start model jobs and the console shows repeated 403s with "kms:Decrypt" in the error message. Can someone triage?

deploy-bot: Scheduled job started: role-squash-v2 by dave_engineering at 03:12 UTC. Affected resources: tenant-role-mappings/*

eli_sre: Looking at infra logs now. I see repeated failures from inference-runner@acme-prod when trying to load model weights. Example log:
```
2026-03-19T03:25:10Z inference-runner@acme-prod KMS ERROR AccessDenied: Caller does not have permission to decrypt
resource=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/models/cryptoKey, principal=svcacct:inference-runner@acme-prod
```
This lines up with the APICalls returning 403 for model init.

mina_security: We rolled out the RBAC refactor (role-squash-v2) last night to collapse tenant roles. Looks like the automation didn't include service account principals with the `svcacct:` prefix for legacy tenants — those bindings were dropped.

sara_support: So this is a regression from last night's refactor. ACME is blocked from running their models, billing unaffected but high severity for them. ETA impact? @eli_sre can we provide a short mitigation now?

eli_sre: I can add a temporary binding to the KMS key policy to restore decrypt for the inference-runner service account. Patch will be quick. Doing a dry-run check first:
```
# verify current bindings
rctl kms get-policy --key projects/redwood/.../cryptoKey
# add binding (dry-run)
rctl kms add-binding --key ... --member svcacct:inference-runner@acme-prod --role roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter --dry-run
```

dave_engineering: Confirmed the role-squash job excluded svcacct prefix. My bad — the mapping script filtered on user: and group: only. Rolling a hotfix to include svcacct and add a guard to reject role removals if they match active principals.

eli_sre: Applying temp grant now.

eli_sre: Applied binding and verified with a test start. Curl to the model start endpoint returned 202 Accepted and subsequent logs show successful decrypt:
```
2026-03-19T03:31:02Z inference-runner@acme-prod KMS INFO Decrypt succeeded for model weights
2026-03-19T03:31:03Z inference-runner@acme-prod MODEL INFO Model load complete
```

sara_support: ACME confirmed they can queue runs again — Jennifer says :tada: and appreciates the quick turnaround. I told them we'll follow up with a postmortem and permanent fix.

mina_security: Next steps: (1) dave to ship role-squash-v2 hotfix that keeps svcacct bindings (2) eli to run a scan for any tenants with zero svcacct bindings in the last 24h (3) add an alert on KMS AccessDenied spikes for tenant-key pairs. I'll own the postmortem writeup and timeline.

dave_engineering: Hotfix pushed to role-squash pipeline — added svcacct handling and safety check. Will run a backfill to restore any dropped bindings and will post the run output here.

eli_sre: Started a tenant scan. Preliminary: 4 tenants showed svcacct binding removals correlated with the job window. I'm running restores for those and will open support tickets for each.

sara_support: Thanks team. I'll reply to ACME with the mitigation summary and ask them to confirm in the next 24h. Will close the support escalation once they ack. :lock:

mina_security: For the postmortem: include timeline, root cause (role-squash excluded svcacct), blast radius, mitigation, and permanent remediation (explicit inclusion + pre-deploy lint + KMS deny spike alert). Scheduling a 30min incident review tomorrow 10am PST.

deploy-bot: role-squash-v2 hotfix run completed by dave_engineering at 03:45 UTC. 4 tenant bindings restored.
